abstract: A 32-year-old man presented with a swelling of the left testis, for which he underwent high inguinal orchiectomy. Histopathological examination of the specimen revealed teratocarcinoma. Further evaluation revealed no metastasis (stage I), and he was followed-up by monthly examination without prophylactic chemotherapy (surveillance). Thirteen months after orchiectomy, AFP and hCG-beta were elevated at 133.8 ng/ml and 0.8 ng/ml respectively. Abdominal CT scan revealed para-aortic masses of recurrent tumor. Although the AFP and hCG-beta levels markedly declined after five courses of COMPE (CDDP, VCR, MTX, PEP, Etoposide) chemotherapy, the retroperitoneal masses had further enlarged and had undergone cystic change. Excision of the residual tumors was performed, and microscopic examination of specimens revealed mature teratoma without malignant components. The diagnosis of the growing teratoma syndrome was therefore made. The growing teratoma syndrome occurs in nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumors following chemotherapy and is characterized by enlargement of metastatic lesions with normal tumor marker levels. Total surgical resection of the mass yields good results, and tumor is unresponsive to chemotherapy. Early recognition of this syndrome is important for successful treatment.
abstract_ja: 32歳男性が左精巣腫脹のため高位鼠径精巣摘除術を受けた。病理組織学的検査で奇形癌と診断された。転移は認めず（病期I）、予防的化学療法は行わず、毎月の診察によるフォローアップ（サーベイランス）を行った。精巣摘除術後13か月でAFPが133.8 ng/ml、hCG-βが0.8 ng/mlに上昇した。腹部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で傍大動脈の再発腫瘍による腫瘤を認めた。COMPE（CDDP、VCR、MTX、PEP、エトポシド）化学療法を5コース施行後、AFPとhCG-βは著明に低下したが、後腹膜腫瘤はさらに増大し嚢胞性変化を来した。残存腫瘍を全外科的切除し、組織学的に悪性成分のない成熟奇形腫と判定された。以上よりgrowing teratoma syndromeと診断した。growing teratoma syndromeは非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に生じ、腫瘍マーカーが正常値であっても転移病変が増大することを特徴とする。腫瘤の全外科的切除により良好な結果が得られ、腫瘍は化学療法に抵抗性を示す。本症候群の早期認識が治療成功に重要である。
